2239-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-413-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-413-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Generous Revival.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-3257-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3693-6593-7803.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Brad Boimler.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-7803.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-2511-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4772-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

4934-5078-7753.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4476-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4476-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

186-4866-7426-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
186-4866-7426-7737.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Heartstone and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-413-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-413-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Lively Dirge.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-4178-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4178-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

323-4496-5220-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

457-1792-3168-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-3168-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Urza's Incubator.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

2113-3525-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

204-1858-2056-2633-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-7296.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4885-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1659-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

11-2631-2928-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2631-2928-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alrund's Epiphany from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

372-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1987-3227.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1669-1850-4482.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-4482.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

3769-3903-3958.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-3903-3958.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Blim.
Blim triggers, causing you to give control of Moderation to an opponent, then causing each player to lose life and discard cards equal to the number of permanents they control but do not own.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

2468-3528.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rise of the Eldrazi, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1365-1379-4853-5315--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5315--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1170-2871-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{R} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Red"
1170-2871-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast red monocolored spells.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Red" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Displacer Kitten +3/+0 until end of turn, and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.

2738-4314-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it triggers itself, Pitiless Plunderer and Pawn of Ulamog.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill one card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Tenacious Dead's ability from step 2, paying {1}{B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of Eldrazi Spawns in step 7, giving you infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens.

478-2092-2645-4916.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
Candelabra of Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
Animate Artifact attached to Candelabra of Tawnos.
478-2092-2645-4916.description:
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by tapping it and paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping the up to six lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

187-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
187-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Karok Wrangler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1964-1987-3075-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1964-1987-3075-4125.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
